excluded.description: Anything published by or for an equipment, chipset, or software vendor: marketing pages, blogs, white papers, datasheets, and webinars, wherever they are hosted.
Community-edited encyclopedias and wikis, even when well referenced; cite their primary sources instead.
Personal or company blogs, forums, Q&A sites, and social media.
News sites and trade publications, which are secondary and frequently vendor-sourced.
Market forecasts and analyst reports, which are not standards or measurements.
Text produced by AI systems, including summaries of real sources.
Charts or tables with no traceable primary source.
